description: Na₂LuC₂O₆F crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.52 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.36 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.65 Å. Lu is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.36 Å. There is one shorter (2.18 Å) and one longer (2.20 Å) Lu-F bond length. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.27-1.30 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.27-1.31 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Lu, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Lu, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Lu, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Lu, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Lu, and one C atom. F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Lu atoms.
